facts.text: Tonight is going to be a great night, I can tell. Pizza is on the way, and Disgust has checked there is no broccoli on it.
facts.why: In the film Riley's pizza place only serves broccoli pizza, and Disgust walks off saying she is done. Joy's real line is 'Who puts broccoli on pizza?!'
